The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operated a '''base''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ketal]]. Eventually, the [[Xucphra Corporation|Xucphra bacta-harvesting corporation]] learned of the base's location and shared it with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who destroyed the base.<ref name="The Business of Bacta" />
